item.title: Ahead Hires Over 300 Employees To Drive VMware VCF As Sales Soar
item.description: Ahead’s VMware sales jumped 80 percent as the IT company hired 300 experts to drive Broadcom VMware Cloud Foundation and VCF 9 deployments.

item.title: ConnectWise CTO On Cloud Backup Cyberattack, M365 Update And Helping Thousands Of Partners
item.description: ConnectWise CTO explains the Cloud Backup cyberattack, impact on thousands of ConnectWise partners and efforts to secure Microsoft 365.
